desc: The Shaman has a well-deserved reputation as one of Spyderco’s most robust and capable folding knives. Building on that hard-earned trust, we are proud to introduce the Shaman Lightweight. It faithfully delivers all the proven performance and design features of the original model in a more carry-friendly format. The handle scales of the Shaman Lightweight feature the same comfortably radiused shape as the original but are injection molded from tough fiberglass-reinforced nylon (FRN). This reduces the knife’s overall weight by nine percent and adds a pebbled texture for enhanced grip. The scales house nested, skeletonized stainless steel liners that provide outstanding structural strength and form the backbone of the knife’s high-strength Compression Lock mechanism.
